---
name: build
description: Execute coding tasks from an approved plan. Use when asked to build a planned feature, implement a task from .opencode/plans, or hand off an approved plan for implementation.
---

# Build a planned task

1. Read the plan at `.opencode/plans/pending-task.md` first. Implement only what the plan contains — no scope additions.
2. Establish the baseline: the skill's evals run green against the current behavior before any rewrite lands.
3. Run the verification feedback loop: type-check, lint, unit tests, e2e — fix and re-run each until it passes; only proceed when all are green.
4. Present manual validation steps to the user; never self-certify the checks that need human eyes.

part.text: Rebuilt the 'build' skill so the workflow is portable: the SKILL.md body carries the plan-first rule, the evals/baseline step, and the verification feedback loop (type-check, lint, unit tests, e2e — fix and re-run until green). Eval written first as the baseline; the body keeps the name and directory unchanged, with project-specific plan paths called out in place. Stop point: manual validation steps are listed for you — the checks that need human eyes are not self-certified.
